events.artist: Ringo Starr and His All Starr Band
events.subtitle: 2026 All Starr Band
events.factual_description: The Anthem presents Ringo Starr and His All Starr Band on September 28, 2026, with doors at 6:30 PM and show at 7:30 PM. Ringo Starr's official July 6 announcement identifies the 2026 All Starr lineup as Steve Lukather, Colin Hay, Warren Ham, Hamish Stuart, Gregg Bissonette and Buck Johnson and lists Washington as one of ten fall dates. Ticketmaster is The Anthem's authorized online ticketing provider and has the exact September 28 event on sale.

enrichment.note: Exact official event, authorized Ticketmaster destination and Apple Music album page are verified.

Exact authorized ticket destination confirms September 28, 2026 at 7:30 PM at The Anthem.

provenance.note: Date, doors/show time and venue were verified against The Anthem; lineup and ten-date tour context against Ringo Starr's official announcement; exact purchase destination against Ticketmaster; current listening against Apple Music. Repository search found no existing record for this Washington date.

en.why_it_matters: The reason this belongs is not celebrity alone. At 86, Ringo remains an active bandleader and drummer, and the All Starr format puts that living rock lineage inside a working ensemble with Steve Lukather, Colin Hay, Hamish Stuart, Gregg Bissonette and other players whose own musical identities matter. It is a chance to hear history functioning as a band rather than as a museum piece.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for it if you are in the DMV. The regional drive makes sense if the living-Beatles and All Starr lineage is the draw, but a ten-date fall tour does not make this a destination trip on its own.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para meterlo no es sólo la celebridad. A los 86 años, Ringo sigue funcionando como baterista y líder de una banda real, y el formato All Starr pone ese linaje vivo del rock junto a músicos con identidad propia como Steve Lukather, Colin Hay, Hamish Stuart y Gregg Bissonette. Es una oportunidad de escuchar historia que todavía opera como banda, no como pieza de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio si estás en el DMV. Vale un manejo regional si te jala el linaje vivo de los Beatles y la All Starr Band, pero al ser una gira de diez fechas no armaría un viaje destino sólo por esta parada.

events.subtitle: Theo Katzman (of Vulfpeck) solo
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Theo Katzman's first appearance at the club on November 10-11, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The venue bills it as a solo performance returning the Vulfpeck founding member and multi-instrumentalist to his singer-songwriter roots, with Katzman alone on vocals, guitar and piano. General web reservations opened August 20, 2026.

enrichment.note: Exact official event, event-specific Blue Note Tokyo reservation destination and Apple Music album page are verified.

sources.note: Official event page confirms dates, two daily set times, solo instrumentation, first Blue Note Tokyo appearance and general reservation opening date.
Event-specific official reservation destination for Theo Katzman's November engagement.
Exact Apple Music album page for Be the Wheel.

provenance.note: Dates, set times, instrumentation and first-appearance context were verified against Blue Note Tokyo; the exact reservation route and Apple Music album page were independently resolved. Repository search found no existing Theo Katzman Blue Note Tokyo record.

en.why_it_matters: What earns this a RADAR slot is the change of frame: the Vulfpeck founder arrives at Blue Note Tokyo without the funk-band machinery, alone on voice, guitar and piano. That exposes the songwriting, harmonic instincts and multi-instrumental identity that can disappear behind the larger ensemble's pocket, and the club is explicitly treating it as a return to his singer-songwriter roots.
en.trip_verdict: Worth considering if your Tokyo dates overlap, especially if you want to hear the musician underneath the Vulfpeck engine. I would not rebuild an evening or a Japan itinerary around it by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Lo que le gana un lugar en el RADAR es el cambio de marco: el fundador de Vulfpeck llega a Blue Note Tokyo sin toda la maquinaria funk de la banda, solo con voz, guitarra y piano. Ahí quedan mucho más expuestos la composición, la armonía y su identidad como multiinstrumentista, justo lo que puede esconderse detrás del pocket del ensamble grande.
es.trip_verdict: Vale considerarlo si coincide con tus días en Tokio, sobre todo si quieres escuchar al músico que hay debajo de la máquina Vulfpeck. No reorganizaría una noche completa ni un itinerario por Japón sólo alrededor de esta fecha.

events.subtitle: The Last Balloon Tour
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Tank and the Bangas on December 11-13, 2026 for The Last Balloon Tour. December 11 has 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets; December 12-13 have 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets. The announced six-member lineup is led by singer/poet Tarriona 'Tank' Ball, and the venue frames the engagement around the 2026 album The Last Balloon, which completes the band's balloon trilogy. General web reservations are scheduled to open August 25, 2026.

enrichment.note: The exact official event and Apple Music album are verified. Blue Note Tokyo states that general web reservations begin August 25, 2026; an exact stable event-specific purchase destination was not independently resolved in this pass, so no generic reservation URL is substituted.

en.why_it_matters: Tank and the Bangas are unusually hard to reduce to a genre: Tank's poetry and elastic vocal phrasing sit inside a band that can move through New Orleans funk, soul, hip-hop and jazz without losing its pocket. This Tokyo run also has a concrete current-project reason to exist, bringing the balloon trilogy to its close with The Last Balloon rather than recycling an old festival set.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the six sets if you are in Tokyo. The combination of the band's live reputation, the current trilogy-closing material and the Blue Note room is strong enough to shape an evening, but not a transpacific trip by itself.
en.listen_before: Tank and the Bangas — The Last Balloon

es.why_it_matters: Tank and the Bangas es una banda difícil de encerrar en un género: la poesía y el fraseo elástico de Tank viven dentro de un ensamble que puede pasar por funk de Nueva Orleans, soul, hip-hop y jazz sin perder el pocket. Además, estas fechas tienen una razón concreta en el presente: llevan a Tokio The Last Balloon, el cierre de la trilogía, en vez de reciclar un set viejo de festival.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio activamente a uno de los seis sets si estás en Tokio. La reputación en vivo de la banda, el material que cierra la trilogía y la escala de Blue Note alcanzan para construir una noche alrededor del show, pero no para justificar por sí solos cruzar el Pacífico.
